data.name: Tai Chi Double

colours.name: Play Orange
alts: Tai Chi Double two-user outdoor tai chi spinner with orange hand wheels

data.description: The Tai Chi Double has two sets of orange hand wheels on one frame, so two people can do tai chi arm circles side by side. Each user stands, grips the handles and turns the wheels in slow circles, together or in opposite directions. The movement works the shoulders, arms and wrists and is easy on the joints, which is why it is popular with senior citizens' groups in parks and society gardens. Our Fun Fitness range lists the Tai Chi Double in Play Orange. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. For the Tai Chi Double, our standard warranty terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in writing. Ask us for a layout.

Each user stands, grips the handles and turns the wheels in slow circles, together or in opposite directions. The movement works the shoulders, arms and wrists and is easy on the joints, which is why it is popular with senior citizens' groups in parks and society gardens. For the Tai Chi Double, our standard warranty terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in writing. Ask us for a layout.

Four wheels mean four bearings to check, and a stiff wheel is the usual sign one needs grease. The double frame is installed self-standing or grouted. Give each user enough standing room in front of their wheels, and keep the area level.
